rebinding_accounting.accounting_andon: Forcing 87,594 would preserve wrong edges or duplicate identities — your Andon is exactly right and is itself evidence that review certification corrects fallback-era errors.
rebinding_accounting.old_location_last_binding_proof: No old location lost its last accepted binding; every old location retains at least one.

updated_scale_verdict.basis: Deterministic extrapolation of the 250-row wave-02 mix; not a confidence interval and not valid if the full-program stratum mix differs.
updated_scale_verdict.recommendation_reason: The 250-row wave reproduces the calibration both-decided rate exactly (78%) and raises compatible decided-pair agreement to 99.49%; doubling to 500 limits each wave to an expected 110 specialist-lane rows and 2 disagreement adjudications while materially reducing the number of program waves.
updated_scale_verdict.recommended_wave_composition: Preserve the observed 36% competing_lexical_senses / 64% unresolved_occurrence_ambiguity mix: 180 lexical and 320 occurrence rows per 500-row wave.
stop_conditions: Any packet/vote integrity, hash, or response-schema failure.
Any label-only match without the stratum-specific shared discriminating evidence addresses.
Any positional decision whose fingerprint_match_candidates is not the singleton canonical_location.
Any both-decided disagreement pattern or decided-pair agreement below 95%.
Gate-qualified yield below 70% or rows needing specialist enrichment above 30% in a wave.
Reviewer one-sided rate above 5%; inspect packet evidence and reviewer calibration before continuing.
